Focused Feature Set

Everything a traveler needs before the next move.

This website keeps the story neat: the app helps tourists decide where to go, how to travel, what to trust, and when to ask for help.

Verified Places

Popular, featured, and nearby destinations with images, details, timings, safety notes, and visibility controls.

Smart Routes

Current location, destination maps, road-style routing, transport choices, station selectors, and city-aware metro flows.

Review Trust

User reviews, image uploads, replies, admin highlighting, and approval rules before public visibility.

Guide Booking

Delhi-focused guide requests can open from a place context and carry useful details into the guide flow.

Travel Booking

Bus, metro, train, cab, auto, and flight partner flows with clearer station and airport selection.

Admin Control

Admin-only access, moderation queues, hidden places, banners, flags, alerts, and remote feature controls.

App Experience

Built around confidence, not clutter.

UniSafeX keeps the main travel decisions close together: select a destination, check trust signals, plan the route, and book help if needed.

Mobile Ready

One product, prepared for Android and iPhone.

Android users can receive an APK or Play Store build. iPhone users need a signed iOS build through TestFlight or the App Store.

Android

APK and release builds are supported with Google Maps, location permissions, image uploads, partner links, and Supabase runtime config.

APKMapsLocationCamera
iOS

iPhone support is configured with bundle id, permissions, Maps key slot, deep links, photo access, and partner URL schemes.
